history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. This is a Presbyterian church at Nongpyndeng, a village/locality in Nongstoin block, West Khasi Hills district (Nongpyndeng shares PIN 793119 with Nongstoin; school records place the NONGPYNDENG-MAWKHLAM cluster in Nongstoin block). It appears in West Khasi Hills Presbyterian-church directories alongside the Ladweitang, New Nongstoin and Ladnongsba churches. The Presbyterian tradition in the Khasi Hills began with Welsh missionaries arriving at Sohra in 1841; the first Khasi converts were baptised in 1846. CSV town 'Nongstoin' is approximately correct: Nongpyndeng is a locality of Nongstoin town (the church listing is about half a kilometre from central Nongstoin). No founding history, congregation size, or service timings are published online (verify).

town_description: Nongpyndeng is a village/locality in Nongstoin block of West Khasi Hills district, Meghalaya (PIN 793119), essentially part of the Nongstoin town area. Nongstoin is the district headquarters with an overwhelmingly Christian population; nearby attractions include Nongkhnum River Island, Weinia Falls and Langshiang Falls.

travel.airport: Shillong Airport (SHL), Umroi, about 100 km by road (verify); Guwahati Airport (GAU) about 140 km (verify). Taxis available from both.
travel.railway: Guwahati railway station (GHY), the nearest major railhead, about 140 km (verify).
travel.road: On NH 44E (Shillong–Nongstoin–Tura highway), within Nongstoin town; walkable from central Nongstoin.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for cool, dry weather; Christmas season is the most festive time in the Khasi Hills.
